pullRequest.bodyHTML: Fixture E11 (review writes): Lo's recordings of comments, replies and reviews are written here as rozed-bot, which can only comment on its own pull request. e11/review.txt changes lines 10, 11, 30 and 50, so the diff has three hunks with lines outside them, and e11/notes.md changes one line, for file-level comments. The recordings delete the comments they can afterwards; submitted reviews stay. It targets e11/base, which adds the files it changes to main. Made by script/e2e/fixtures.sh in scornz/lo.
